title.zh: 【币安将于 11 月 10 日停止矿池及相关服务】
title.en: 【币安将于 11 月 10 日停止矿池及相关服务】

current_state.zh: Binance announced it will terminate Binance Pool and its associated services — including Pool Savings, cloud mining, trade acceleration, notification and API functions — on 10 November at 15:00, requiring miners to redirect hashrate to other pools and complete redemption or settlement steps by 11 November 07:59, with historical data accessible on the pool page until 24 November 15:00.
current_state.en: Binance announced it will terminate Binance Pool and its associated services — including Pool Savings, cloud mining, trade acceleration, notification and API functions — on 10 November at 15:00, requiring miners to redirect hashrate to other pools and complete redemption or settlement steps by 11 November 07:59, with historical data accessible on the pool page until 24 November 15:00.
